newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed in lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed in lacklustre trade.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mixed on Thursday in lacklustre trade as market participants were wary of taking large positions ahead of the spot expiry next Tuesday, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.6 yen per kg lower to 0.6 yen up. Benchmark February was 0.4 yen lower at 140.3 yen.
Activity was spurred by technical factors amid a dearth of fresh factors, with prices drifting within narrow ranges.
Traders said trade houses were expected to be willing to take deliveries at the expiry, but expectations of a large number of deliveries caused investors to stay on the sidelines.
